newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling eases marginally on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling eases marginally on dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling was a touch weaker against the dollar on Tuesday as exporters held out of the market waiting for an indication of the shilling's near-term direction, dealers said.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 53.46 against the dollar compared to 53.45 on Friday, while against the pound it stood a commercial rate of 87.46 from 87.64.
"A lot of people are holding on the sidelines to see what direction the shilling will take," a dealer added.
The 53.50 level is the next psychological level, the dealers said.
The money market eased marginally on an inflow of about one billion shillings from last week's treasury bill auction.
Overnight rates were posted at 9-10 percent compared to 10-15 percent on Friday. Monday was a public holiday in Kenya.
